# Files the build may download into ~/.opennlp (core's DownloadUtil directory) and its
# eval subdirectory (the addons-eval data root). The CI cache key hashes this file, so
# add, remove or rename an entry to invalidate the cache. One path per line, relative to
# ~/.opennlp; comment lines start with #.
#
# Models the coref evaluations load (OpenNLP 1.5 and 2.5.4 model sets).
en-ner-person.bin
en-ner-location.bin
en-ner-organization.bin
en-chunker.bin
en-pos-maxent.bin
opennlp-en-ud-ewt-sentence-1.3-2.5.4.bin
opennlp-en-ud-ewt-tokens-1.3-2.5.4.bin
#
# Eval data of addons-eval, see addons-eval/README.md for each layout.
eval/vector-search/model/
eval/vector-search/passages.jsonl
eval/vector-search/dictionary.tsv
eval/sentencepiece/
eval/ud/train.conllu
eval/ud/test.conllu
eval/coref/ontogum/
